nodes.name: Validate message_id
nodes.notes: Rejects anything that isn't UUID-shaped before it reaches a shell command in the Apply proposed action step.

nodes.name: Get message
nodes.notes: Native Supabase node, same pattern as build-campaign.json's 'Get campaign'/'Get client' nodes — plain-string keyName/tableId, proven working against this instance. Replaces the earlier $env-based HTTP call, since $env access is blocked here.

nodes.name: Get campaign for action
nodes.notes: Only runs on the 'has proposed_action' branch. Looks up the campaign this message is linked to (messages.campaign_id, set by client-email-to-draft.json) so we know which Google Ads resources to mutate.

nodes.name: Refresh Google Ads token (action)
nodes.notes: Same pattern as build-campaign.json — explicit OAuth2 refresh call rather than an n8n Google OAuth2 credential.

nodes.name: Build campaign action body
nodes.notes: Maps proposed_action.action_type to the right Google Ads mutate call. Only 3 action types exist (matches the tightened structured-output schema in client-email-to-draft.json): update_daily_budget, pause_campaign, resume_campaign.

nodes.name: Apply campaign change
nodes.notes: Actually calls the Google Ads API to apply the approved change. Same jsonHeaders/JSON.stringify pattern proven in build-campaign.json.

nodes.name: Insert outbound message
nodes.notes: Replaces the old Gmail 'Send reply email' node — no more email. The approved reply becomes a new outbound row in `messages`, which the client sees on their next portal load (ClientPortalPage.tsx).

nodes.name: Mark inbound message replied
nodes.notes: Marks the ORIGINAL inbound row handled (status='sent') so MessageThread.tsx stops showing its draft-editing box. The actual reply text now lives in the new outbound row from 'Insert outbound message', not on this row.
